title: Einmaligen Bureau-Runtime-Refresh für Navigate-Publikation autorisieren
goal: Schließe genau einmal den aktuellen immutable Bureau-Runtime- und Registry-Snapshot-Drift, der die typisierte Publikation des bereits deduplizierten Semantic-Navigate-Candidates 7612 blockiert. Unmittelbar vor dem einzigen Runtime-Effekt müssen aktueller GitHub-main, dessen grüne Pflichtchecks, eine frische Runtime-Refresh-Observation und der daraus abgeleitete target_sha256 neu gebunden werden. Diese Authority darf nach erfolgreichem Refresh und Closeout niemals wiederverwendet werden.

approval.note: Single-use bootstrap authority only. The effect additionally requires a fresh target observation, target-bound break-glass evidence and the exact live leases demanded by the runtime-refresh intent. No repository merge, queue, claim, dispatch, StateStore-history or foreign-work authority is granted.

acceptance.assertion: Immediately before the single execution, current GitHub main, the relevant merge history and required checks are freshly observed. Any drift invalidates older observations or intents.
prepare-intent binds approval_task_id exactly to this TaskSpec and approval_reference exactly to the freshly observed target_sha256; without both bindings no runtime effect is permitted.

This TaskSpec can authorize at most one successful runtime refresh. After successful effect and result-bound closeout it becomes terminal and is never reused; later runtime drift requires a new authority TaskSpec.
apply uses only the exact Resource-Keys from the fresh runtime-refresh intent under one matching owner; missing, foreign, expired or drifted leases abort before effect.

After apply, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree and canonical registry snapshot bind the same source commit; StateStore integrity remains valid and fresh readback proves the new runtime identity.

The refresh exists only to restore the normal typed publication path for candidate-ff4df9441862804e26cc28b0 / event 7612. It does not itself publish, ready, claim, dispatch, merge or implement the Navigate task.
The execution does not weaken Runtime, Registry, Queue, Claim, Dispatch, Lease, Review or Merge gates and does not mutate foreign worktrees, leases or processes.

rollback.strategy: If cutover fails or has an ambiguous outcome, do not assert a new deployment truth and do not rewrite Registry, Queue or StateStore history. Preserve the last integrity-valid immutable release and use only the existing result/readback/release/verify-then-retry runtime-refresh contract.

publication_path.scope: exactly this one new task file
